representationDecision: The museum remains a distinct persistent institution inside Holmenkollen National Ski Arena; the jump tower remains part of the existing parent arena identity and does not get a separate place marker.

supersededDecision.reason: This early retry used the exact official address fallback after no unique named OSM museum object was found. Later source verification showed that current visitor-facing VisitOSLO, booking and Holmenkollen/Skiforeningen sources use Kongeveien 5 for the Ski Museum.

parentOverlapAudit.conclusion: Expected parent/child physical overlap, not identity duplication. The museum is a distinct institution and visitor place; the jump tower and broader arena remain represented by the parent place.
